connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Log in mit ut LinkedIn -account dat eur advertenties behiert. Leadrat lees allein eur advertensieaccounts, Lead Gen Form leads en advertentiestatistieke en sjik conversies die geer insjtelt.
connect.need2: ‘n Rol op de gekoppelde bedriefspagina (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator of Analyst) - LinkedIn vereis dat ‘t leads deilt.
connect.need3: ‘n Telefoonnummervraog op eur Lead Gen Forms - leads zoonder ‘n tillefoonnummer kinne neet weure toegeveug.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Vertel LinkedIn welke vaan zien leads echte prospecte zien gewore. Es ‘n LinkedIn lead ‘n status bereik dee geer hie-oonder kies, meldt Leadrat t aon LinkedIn , zoetot eur campagnerapporte leadkwaliteit toene en LinkedIn mie lui kin vinde wie eur beste leads. Allein de LinkedIn -lead ID en ‘n one-way hash vaan de e-mail were gestuurd.
